content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates must fulfill the following essential qualifications and skill requirements to apply for the Research Assistant position: Essential Qualifications: Post Graduate Degree (including integrated PG degrees) OR Four Years Graduate Degree in Engineering / IT / CS. Relevant disciplines include Computer Science, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, Electronics, Mathematics, or allied areas. Skill Requirements: Strong mathematical and coding skills, proficiency in Python and Pytorch coding, knowledge of front-end and back-end development tools, and proficiency in ML and DL coding, training, and deployment.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The selected candidate will receive a consolidated fellowship of Rs. 45,880/- per month. The position is temporary and is offered for a duration of 8 months, which is subject to the successful completion of a one-month probation period.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IIIT Delhi Research Assistant
content_sections.text: Visit the official Google Form application link provided in the notification. Fill in all required details accurately regarding your academic qualifications and coding proficiency. Submit the completed application form on or before 25 October 2026.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: The committee may establish a shortlisting criterion to review applications. Only shortlisted candidates will be notified via email and invited to participate in the interview round. IIIT Delhi norms will apply during the hiring process, and the Institute's decision will be final in all respects.
